android.desc:
MimiLog is a free, offline baby diary for parents of children 0 to 3. Every feeding, nap, diaper, pump, growth measurement and fever reading stays on your phone. No ads, no signup, no subscription. Forever.

Built for the 3am moments when the last thing you need is a paywall.


WHY PARENTS CHOOSE MIMILOG

Free forever. No in-app purchases, no premium tier, no upsell screens.
No ads. Not a single banner, not a single interstitial.
Offline-first. Works on a plane, in a hospital basement, anywhere without Wi-Fi.
No signup. Open the app and start logging in under ten seconds.
Private by design. Your baby's data never leaves your device.
Dark mode. Kind to your eyes during night feeds.
Multi-baby. Perfect for twins or siblings close in age.


WHAT YOU CAN LOG

FEEDING
A breastfeeding timer that remembers which side you started on. A bottle log in milliliters, whether it is breast milk or formula. A quiet place for every spoonful of solids. Night feeds between 10pm and 6am are detected automatically.

SLEEP
One-tap naps and overnight sleep. A gentle sleep schedule that adapts as your infant grows into a toddler. Total day sleep, total night sleep and the next predicted wake window — all on one screen, free of charge.

DIAPER
Pee, poo, or both. One tap, done. A clean daily counter and a kind nudge if your newborn's wet diaper count dips below the recommended minimum.

PUMPING
A pump log for left, right or both sides. Volume, duration and output rate per minute, session by session, as private as your own diary.

GROWTH AND HEALTH
Weight, height and head circumference charted on WHO percentile curves, built in, free, no paywall, no hidden export fee. A complete baby temperature log with seven-level fever classification, from hypothermia to dangerous, plus a trend line showing whether today's reading is rising, steady or falling.

MORE
Bath time, doctor visits, free-form journal notes and a shared timer that survives a phone reboot. Full statistics by day, week and month. Twins, siblings and multiple babies, each with a separate profile, strictly kept apart.


THE PRIVACY PROMISE

Your baby's data stays on your device. Every entry lives in a local SQLite database, never on our servers, because we do not run any. No analytics libraries. No advertising identifiers. No hidden third-party SDKs.

quotes.text:
one open-source, locally hosted one (that's slightly inconvenient if you don't have a home server that can sync logs) - https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy

and a really obscure and clearly vibe-designed one (that still works fine) that only fired off a single Firebase call noting an install: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mimiapp.mimilog&hl=en_US&pli=1

one caveat is that I haven't done anything like longterm use testing - just account setup and a handful of inputs like a specific feed time and amount, etc. if these apps are firing off data with delayed intervals, I wouldn't have captured it

re Nanit, yes, it sent a request to https://r.clarity.ms/collect with a 1.1KB payload after only a few seconds of use. everything I've read about MS Clarity and MS in general around their data practices makes me extremely wary that such a popular app collects this much data
quotes.story_title: Big Tech ruined the cloud, so we're renaming ours
